products.name: NE Roots Assam Bhut Jolokia & Bamboo Shoot Pickle (Khorisa)
products.description: The pride of Assam. World-famous fiery Bhut Jolokia (Ghost Peppers) hand-pounded with tender fermented bamboo shoot (Khorisa) and steeped in pure cold-pressed mustard oil.

products.name: NE Roots Assam Nemu (Lime) & Mustard Oil Pickle
products.description: Geographical Indication (GI) tagged Assam Nemu lemons known for their intense floral citrus aroma, cured in golden yellow mustard paste, organic turmeric, and cold-pressed oil.

products.name: NE Roots Sikkim Dalle Khursani Round Cherry Chilli Pickle
products.description: Vibrant round red Dalle Khursani cherry peppers from the Eastern Himalayas. Bursting with robust pungent heat and fermented in mustard oil with Himalayan mountain herbs.

products.name: NE Roots Wild Hill Garlic & Mustard Seed Achaar
products.description: Whole peeled aromatic mountain garlic cloves tempered with split yellow mustard seeds, Naga ginger, Kashmiri red chilli, and steeped in virgin cold-pressed mustard oil.

products.name: NE Roots Sun-Cured Raw Mango & Bhoot Jolokia Fusion
products.description: Crisp raw Indian mangoes sun-dried for 14 days and infused with a touch of Assam Ghost Pepper for a tantalizing kick that balances traditional mango sourness.

products.name: NE Roots Banarasi Bharwa Lal Mirch with Assam Mustard
products.description: Thick hand-selected red chillies generously stuffed with tangy amchur, freshly ground roasted spices, and slow-matured in aromatic Assamese mustard oil.

reviews.author: Nilav Jyoti
reviews.flavour: Assam Kazi Nemu King Lime Pickle
reviews.title: Incredible fresh aroma!
reviews.comment: Tastes just like my home made pickle!

reviews.author: Kaushik Goswami
reviews.flavour: Assam Bhut Jolokia & Bamboo Shoot Pickle
reviews.title: Authentic Khorisa taste! Reminds me of home in Tezpur
reviews.comment: The pungency of the mustard oil and the authentic fermented bamboo shoot aroma is unmatched. Usually commercial brands don't get the Khorisa balance right, but NE Roots nailed the grandmother's touch!

reviews.author: Dr. Malavika Saikia
reviews.flavour: Assam Kazi Nemu King Lime Pickle
reviews.title: Best Kazi Nemu pickle in India! That floral citrus aroma is heavenly
reviews.comment: I live away from Assam and missed Kazi Nemu terribly. The moment I opened the jar, the fragrance filled my kitchen. The mustard seed paste and soft peel are pure perfection. Delivered in 3 days safely!

reviews.author: Vikramjit Roy
reviews.flavour: Sikkim Dalle Khursani Round Cherry Chilli
reviews.title: Fiery punch with intense flavor! Must-try for chilli lovers
reviews.comment: Dalle Khursani is difficult to find outside Sikkim/Darjeeling. The whole cherry chillies bursting with mustard oil and fenugreek elevate plain dal-rice to gourmet status.

reviews.author: Sneha Phukan
reviews.flavour: Wild Hill Garlic & Mustard Seed Achaar
reviews.title: Super flavorful and not overly sour like mass market pickles
reviews.comment: The garlic cloves are tender and soaked in rich cold-pressed mustard oil. You can genuinely taste that there are zero artificial preservatives.

reviews.author: Prateek Barua
reviews.flavour: Sun-Cured Raw Mango & Bhoot Jolokia Fusion
reviews.title: The Ghost Pepper kick is brilliant!
reviews.comment: Traditional mango achaar with that subtle, building heat of King Chilli. Loved the packaging and the glass jar quality.

team.name: Soumarjyoti Bhuyan

team.name: Ananya Dutta
team.bio: Over 12 years perfecting ancestral Assamese sun-curing methods, mustard oil tempering, and GI-tagged citrus preservation. Ensuring every jar meets pristine FSSAI hygienic standards.

team.name: Rupjyoti Kalita
team.bio: Directly partnering with smallholder farming clusters in Tezpur and Golaghat for fresh Bhut Jolokia, organic Kazi Nemu lemons, and wild mountain garlic, ensuring fair trade and zero middlemen.

companyStory.headline: Rooted in Assam, Dedicated to North Eastern Heritage
companyStory.narrative: NE Roots (North East Roots) was born out of a profound passion to celebrate and share the untapped culinary biodiversity of North East India. From the mist-laden hills of Assam to the fertile riverbanks of the Brahmaputra, our recipes are rooted in age-old family traditions, sun-curing practices, and authentic spices.
companyStory.mission: Our mission is to create a globally recognized North Eastern FMCG brand that delivers uncompromising taste, 100% vegetarian purity, and genuine regional heritage while empowering local Assamese farmers and rural communities.
commitments: No Chemical Preservatives or Synthetic Colours
